title: Sort the inbox *before coffee.*
intro: Paste a partner's email: Claude reads it in any language, routes it to the right desk, pulls out the trip facts, lists what's missing and drafts a reply in the sender's language for our team to check.
staffNote: Built for the Local Host team. Real emails contain personal data, so the live tool asks for a staff access key.
